questions.q: Which mask must be in the serial line for the UART of a DJI O3/Walksnail/HDZero air unit in Betaflight 2025.12?
questions.explain: 131073 = MSP (1) + VTX_MSP (1 << 17 = 131072). DisplayPort is taken from the first port that has both bits set (config.c); 2048 is SmartAudio, 64 is Serial RX.

questions.q: What will Betaflight 2025.12 do when booting with a config where UART4 has the mask 131072 and the other ports are fine?
options: Enable DisplayPort on UART4, but without MSP replies
Reset the whole port config to the board defaults
Disable only UART4 and leave the other ports alone
Add the MSP bit itself and save the mask 131073
questions.explain: isSerialConfigValid(): VTX_MSP alone (bitCount == 1) is not allowed, the function returns false, and config.c calls pgResetFn_serialConfig — all ports are reset, the receiver included.

questions.q: An air unit manual tells you to enter set displayport_msp_serial = 3. What will the Betaflight 2025.12 CLI answer?
options: It will make UART4 the DisplayPort port until reboot
INVALID NAME: the variable was removed in 4.4
It will make UART3 the DisplayPort port and save
It will require save, then apply it after a reboot
questions.explain: displayport_msp_serial existed in 4.2–4.3; it is not in settings.c of the 4.4, 4.5 and 2025.12 branches. The DisplayPort port is determined by the MSP + VTX_MSP mask.

questions.q: How does the value of osd_link_quality_pos encode an element in column 46, row 1, visible in profile 1?
A layout made on a 53×20 canvas was loaded onto an aircraft with HDZero (a 50×18 canvas). What will osdInit() do with an element at the point (1, 18)?
options: Move it to (1, 17) — clamp it to the last row
Scale it to (1, 16) in proportion to the 50×18 canvas
Hide the element by clearing the profile 1 visibility flag
Leave it at (1, 18), and the goggles will cut off the bottom row
questions.explain: osdInit() only clamps x ≥ cols to cols − 1 and y ≥ rows to rows − 1 and keeps the profile and type. The firmware has no proportional remapping, so elements can land on top of each other.

questions.q: Which air unit in the list must not be powered directly from 4S per the manufacturer's specification?
options: DJI O3 Air Unit
DJI O4 Air Unit Pro
DJI O4 Air Unit
Caddx Vista (with a camera)
questions.explain: O4 Air Unit: 3.7–13.2 V, BEC ≥ 10 W (5 V/2 A). The O3, O4 Pro and Vista — 7.4–26.4 V, 2S–6S.

questions.q: An aircraft with a DJI O3 is controlled from a DJI radio. Where does the yellow DJI HDL/S.Bus wire go, and which provider do you set?
options: To the TX of any free UART, CRSF
To the FC's S.Bus pad, serialrx_provider = SBUS
To the RX of the DisplayPort port, the SBUS provider
To the LED_STRIP pad, the PPM provider through resource
questions.explain: Per the DJI manual the yellow wire goes to the flight controller's S.Bus; on an F4 the S.Bus pad goes through an inverter. A receiver is not combined with the DisplayPort port; with ELRS the yellow wire is not connected.

questions.q: Why can a DJI O4 Air Unit, powered on the bench without airflow, shut down after a few minutes?
options: Overheat protection: without airflow a cold start gives about 2.5 min
Betaflight turns the VTX off after 5 minutes on the ground without arming
The air unit did not get a link with the DJI radio and went to sleep
vtx_low_power_disarm = ON turns the air unit's RF off completely
questions.explain: The DJI manual: overheating on the ground means a protective shutdown; the idle time from a cold start at 25 °C is about 2.5 min for the O4 and about 20 min for the O4 Pro. On the bench a fan is needed.
